PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 13th September, 2024 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No.KP/39 of 2024/PRHRDD/KRT/e-file/14/2024/2396/KH:- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) of 
section 227 read with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat 
hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), Class III, in the Superior 
Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 2014, namely:-  
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), Class III, in the Superior Panchayat 
Service Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2024. 
(2) 
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.

blocks.text:
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
183-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 20-09-2024 
 [ PART  I-A 
2. 
In the Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 
2014, in rule 3, for clause (b), the following clause shall be substituted, namely:- 
(b) “possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering obtained from Technical Examination Board or any of the 
Universities or institutions established or incorporated by or under the Central or State Act in India; or any other 
educational institution recognized as such or declared as deemed to be a University under section 3 of the 
University Grants Commission Act, 1956; or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government:  
Provided that the candidate holding bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering shall not be eligible to 
apply;”. 
 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
NARENDRA VAGHELA, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
---------- 
Signed by:BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
